testCoverage: 22 semantic bootstrap + 24 emitted display/Intuition instruction + 146 full-ROM boot (one fresh compilation plus 145 exact-image cases). Focused ten overlap. Twenty-one separate standalone-reader-root cases and other instruction/filesystem cases were not rerun.

failures.symptom: Crack intro obtains $7FFFC as graphics base and calls $7FE76; later executes invalid addresses and stays black.
failures.cause: Exec is absent from its own public library list; native intro follows Exec successor twice to graphics.

failures.symptom: Registration correction reaches title but intro and trainer remain black.
failures.cause: No permanent graphics VBlank server consumes caller-written gb_LOFlist; copinit never jumps to COP2LC.

failures.symptom: Intermediate boot suite: two checksum failures, two over-specific BitMap flag expectations, one console-test observation race.
failures.resolution: Checksum restoration now sums Exec SoftVer through MaxExtMem; tests check version-independent BitMap fields and wait for the guest RAW0 readiness marker. Three component assertions also follow the corrected COP1LC startup/COP2LC display split. A later full suite found the boot console still used the direct COP1 path; its public pointer and Copper-mode publication are corrected. The older memory probe now sums the native checksum range rather than the Library prefix.

fixes: Publish named/versioned Exec in LibList and insert boot expansion immediately after it, before graphics. Generic AddLibrary ordering is unchanged.
Remove obsolete duplicate minimal intuition.library installation; full native Intuition remains installed at reset.

Install permanent priority-10 native graphics VBlank server; publish caller-written LOFlist to COP2LC and copinit to COP1LC. Chip startup list waits until scanline 12 before COPJMP2. No active-View or allocation-ownership requirement.

LoadView publishes the public raw hardware-list pointer, maintains the COP1/COP2 split, and replaces it with an empty list before display resources are freed. The boot console now publishes through the same graphics fields and restores its display mode in its Copper list each field.
Restore Exec checksum over the native public checksum range.

nativeEvidence.note: Read-only RAM dumps and bounded instruction stepping; no guest state injection. Native timings and glyphs differ; cross-ROM bitmap equality is not claimed.

xenon2: Band trainer at 2000; recorded left-click retains defaults

Insert game disk at 30000 in CopperStart and native control

limits: Only original supplied Xenon disk 1 is available. No gameplay, saving, disk-two handoff, trainer features, continuous audio fidelity, interlaced graphics, full graphics VBlank task-owner conformance, generic Workbench or host-throughput acceptance claim. Frozen media engine/CPU dependencies are unchanged. Native ROM fixture and media runner use separately recorded engine binaries; no host OS shims or package release.
